div.div:
Gate 1 · schema compatibility
:contracts:test · SchemaCompatibilityTest
Every .avsc must stay mutually readable with the committed baseline. Offline, so the verdict cannot be changed by a shared registry.
Also fails if a schema disappears from the baseline, or leaves the dev.engnotes.fes.events namespace.

div.div:
Gate 2 · plane isolation
checkPlaneIsolation
No ingestion, streaming or audit module may depend on a :services:agent project, or on a group starting with org.neo4j, com.anthropic, dev.langchain4j or io.github.ollama4j.
Prints the module count, so a vacuous pass is visible.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Gate 3 · the ACL policies render
renderKafkaAcls
Reads every service's kafka-acls.yml with the same parser the tests use and writes build/kafka-acls.args.
Runs on every build, so a malformed policy fails here rather than days later when someone brings the stack up. Fails outright if no policy is found.

div.div:
Gate 4 · the tests
every module's check task
143 tests across 27 classes at the last full run.
Unit: pure logic, no Spring context.
Integration: a real broker on apache/kafka-native plus a real Schema Registry.
Authorization: a real broker on apache/kafka with SASL and the StandardAuthorizer.
A running Docker daemon is required.
